idea: Short cut from the long Opus 5 vs Opus 5.5 test, with a new hook. Opens on the bill: one AI charged $1.45 for a job, the other 27 cents (API-equivalent). Setup: Opus 5 vs Opus 5.5, one try each at the same real dashboard job, hidden tests. Escalation: 53 s vs 265 s, both 18/18, 5 steps vs 31 steps explain the smaller API bill. Punchline (~80%): Opus 5.5 never checked its page in a browser; KAXO hugs the robot: 'It skipped checking its own work. [pause] I've never felt so seen.' Loop: KAXO's last line 'So yes, I'm upgrading, because...' leads back into the opening line about the bill.
real_fact: Opus 5 vs Opus 5.5, one run each, same task, Claude Code default settings: 265 s vs 53 s, 31 vs 5 turns, $1.45 vs $0.27 API-equivalent (total_cost_usd, run on a subscription, no real payment), hidden tests 18/18 for both, Opus 5.5 did not open its page in a browser (Node script only). (mənbə: content/reports/2026-09-25-opus-5-5-test.md)

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One AI charged a dollar forty-five for this job.
lines.text_tr: Bir yapay zekâ bu iş için bir dolar kırk beş aldı.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Each got one try at the same real dashboard job.
lines.text_tr: İkisi de aynı gerçek dashboard işini birer kez denedi.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Opus 5.5 was done in fifty-three seconds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The older model took two hundred and sixty-five.
lines.text_tr: Eski model iki yüz altmış beş saniye sürdü.

lines.speaker: kaxo
lines.text: I can't find my remote that fast.
lines.text_tr: Ben o sürede kumandamı bile bulamam.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Yet both passed all eighteen hidden tests.
lines.text_tr: Yine de ikisi de on sekiz gizli testin hepsini geçti.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The new one took five steps, not thirty-one.
lines.text_tr: Yenisi otuz bir değil, beş adımda bitirdi.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fewer steps mean a smaller API bill.
lines.text_tr: Daha az adım, daha küçük API faturası demek.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But it never checked its page in a browser.
lines.text_tr: Ama sayfasını tarayıcıda hiç kontrol etmedi.

shots.prompt: KAXO slouched on a saggy couch with his arm around a small boxy grey robot (simple box body, round screen face with two dot eyes). The robot slouches in exactly the same lazy way, both of them sinking into the cushions side by side. KAXO looks down at the robot with proud, teary, deeply moved eyes and a trembling little smile. Warm lamp light. Vertical composition: the two figures fill the middle of the frame, couch at the bottom third, plain wall above their heads, camera at couch height, medium-close shot. No text anywhere.

lines.speaker: kaxo
lines.text: It skipped checking its own work. [pause] I've never felt so seen.
lines.text_tr: Kendi işini kontrol etmeyi atladı. [pause] Kendimi hiç bu kadar anlaşılmış hissetmemiştim.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The full test is in the long video.
